I get to Drunken Pork's stop and she is still out. I walk back to try to get her up and she is flopping like a fish. I call dispatch to let them know I do need that help and an officer pulls up in just a few seconds. Immediately the officer recognizes Drunken Pork and calls for the ambulance.
